notes.title: 1.0.2.1 Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We're pushing this little patch to fix some issues we (or you)'ve catched!

Thanks a lot for playing Shogun Showdown, and for the cool reviews we see all day. That's really heartwarming!

Here's the list of the changes :


Changelog

 Bug fix: On MacOS, if you alt-tabbed / switched workspace the game would become unresponsive.
 Bug fix: Enemies and heroes "death animation" would not trigger under certain conditions leading the "death standing".
 Bug fix: Thorns retaliation damage was set to 0 after quitting the game and continuing a run
 Bug fix: True Mastery quest could incorrectly trigger after completing only 4 out or 5 heroes
 Fixed a few typos (English & Chinese)

[previewyoutube=Y1sJu_B1NFY;full]https://youtu.be/Y1sJu_B1NFY[/previewyoutube]

We hope you will enjoy this big 1.0 milestone and can’t wait to hear your impressions. See you on September 5th!

notes.title: New update out now!
notes.notes:
Endless Replayability Fest is here, along with a new update for Shogun Showdown -- including key remapping for gamepad and keyboard, new upgrades and shop and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084000/Shogun_Showdown/

Full Patch Notes:

New stuff:

 New upgrade: +2DMG, +3CD
 New upgrade: Warrior's Gamble
 New Rei the Rutheless alt boss in bamboo grove (unlocked by defeating the shogun)
 New environment graphics for shops
 New Moonlit Port Shop (services: skull exchange, skull reroll, bone soup).
 Added Italian localization
 Option to select different gamepad glyphs
 New default gamepad layout
 Option to switch between "default" and "alternative" gamepad layouts
 Key remapping for gamepad and keyboard
 Keyboard only mode

Tweaks:

 Sword renamed to Katana and buffed from 1CD to 0CD
 Tweaks to enemy spawning positions probabilities
 When you reroll a reward multiple times, you are now guaranteed not to get repeated outcomes.
 Tweaks to upgrades probabilities (slightly lower chance of -1CD)
 Renamed "+1 max level" upgrade to "+1 upgrade slots"
 Restructured the UI for reroll/skill rewards
 Reworked poison effect graphics
 Shop on shogun island is unveiled on the map after defeating Kowa/Sato (before it was unveiled only after defeating Hideyoshi/Nobunaga)
 Removed togglable controls summary button (might reintroduce it in the future)
 Reworked tutorial
 Restructured some menus
 New font for Japanese/Chinese. This solves the issue with the previous font where a "smaller font" was used as a fallback option if some logograms were missing from the main font.

Bug fixes:

 Fixed bug with d6 sometimes not being sellable.
 Fixed graphical glitch for shinobi smoke bomb + karma death
 Fixed some shop navigation issues with gamepad
 Fixed issue if you give up during a reward with a gamepad.
 Fixed issue with shogun phase 2 appearing in the wrong cell if the killing blow was pushing shogun phase 1.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084000/Shogun_Showdown/

If you want to try out the game, the public demo is still available and has been updated as well:
 new tutorial
 gamepad support
 save game will carry over to main game
 different final boss for the demo
 removed "stamps" in the demo

Have fun! 🎉
-Roboatino & Goblinz Publishing

notes.title: New update + price increase!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As part of the Pirates vs Ninjas Fest, we have a new update available for you now, which we are detailing just below. 
We would also like to let you know that we will update Shogun Showdown's pricing in a week, moving from $9.99 / €9.99 to $14.99 / €14.99.
The reason we are doing this is that we believe the game's current content and replayability justify such a price. Considering we will also add more content for the 1.0 launch and continue supporting the game afterward to make it the most complete game possible.

That's why we have applied a 30% discount to the game, so this is your last chance to grab it at this price for a while. 
We hope you will understand our decision, which we truly believe is fair.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084000/Shogun_Showdown/

The Corruption Update - Full Patch Notes

New Content

 Corrupted Bosses may appear from Day 4 (new ascension level)
 New Locations: Forsaken Grounds and Theatre of Illusions
 New Enemies: Warden, Blight Charger, Strider, Kabukai
 New Bosses: Fumiko the Fallen and Sato the Stagemaster
 New Consumables: Rain of Mirrors and Lucky Die
 New Skills: Close Combat, Central Dominion, Kobushi Combo, Combo Boon, Chilling Blood, Iron Skin, Mamushi Move, Chikara Crush
 New Tiles: Back Shadow Dash, Mon, Twin Tessen, Sai, Blazing Suisei
 New Lore: boss barks.

Tweaks and balance

 Rearranged Day Buffs (ascension). Day 2: elite enemies, Day 3: lower consumable drops.
 Cooldown upgrade in shop: from -1CD 15$ to -2CD 20$
 Tiles are now grouped into "common" and "uncommon". Uncommon tiles have lower probability of being rewarded.
 Monomancer: reduced max skill level to 1.
 Buffed Knockback Punch: from 5CD to 4CD
 Buffed Cursing Move skill: no longer increases special move CD by 1.
 Iwao is now freezable. Nobunaga is now unfreezable.
 Added visual effect when a skill is triggered.
 Reworked stamps display, added "days completion marks".

Play Now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084000/Shogun_Showdown/

notes.title: Gamepad Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm glad to announce that the first goal of our roadmap is there!

GAMEPAD UPDATE IS OUT NOW!

This does mean that you can play the game with your favorite controller! As some of you might have seen already, we've been able to get the "Steamdeck Verified" check so that's also great news for Steamdeck people!

Some of you might not be aware though, there is a little bad news. We wanted to get the key/button binding in this update too, however we had some difficulties having it ready and tested yet. We'd rather publish the gamepad update without it since a lot of people were waiting for it.

Key and buttons remapping is still in the pipe and is definitely happening, you just have to be a bit more patient, and we'll give you more news as we'll have some to share!
For now you'd have to use the default layout, don't hesitate to play the tutorial again to get familiar with it!

Along with bug fixing, here's the major changes for the 0.6 version :

 Gamepad support.
 Steam Deck compatibility.
 New tile enchantment: Perfect Strike.
 Increased max skull limit to 9999.

We'll be releasing more minor updates with improvements on the input system (e.g. key rebinding), so let us know your thoughts!
Stay tuned for the next major update, which will be all about new content!

Cheers,

~Mirko and Goblinz team

notes.title: Shogun Showdown's Cloud update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We  had issues with the Steam Cloud. Long story short, it only worked between the same OS, and, only the metaprogression was saved. But if you stopped mid-run to continue on another computer, you'd have to start your run over again

From now on, you should be able to keep your save and ongoing run saved to the cloud, no matter which OS you use!

The main use-case of this would be with the Steamdeck, being able to save and quit on PC then continue your run on Steamdeck.

Talking about Steamdeck, someone in the team made an unofficial gamepad layout, so you've got a layout to play with before the official gamepad support comes.

Have a fantastic week!

notes.title: Small Update - 0.5.6 (30/06/2023)
notes.notes:
Hey there! Here's the changelog for the first small update of Shogun Showdown! We adressed some bugs we/you found
A lot of you folks requested to be able to unassign/lock the mouse wheel. It requires a bit of translation, so it's not in this first small update, but this will come!
Later (but it'll be in a major update), our plan is to let you rebind your keys (and buttons when there will be gamepad support) as you want!

Thank you so much for your kind messages since EA launch, and here's the changelog!

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a soft-lock situation when entering a reward room with only maxed-out tiles.
 Fixed a soft-lock situation in the Twin boss fight when one twin is killed by being pushed on a trap.
 Fixed a soft-lock situation when both player and Shogun die in the same turn.
 Fixed a major bug involving incompatible alpha-version save files (from an old itch.io alpha version) causing startup errors.
 Fixed minor localization and translation issue.
